semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Quatek International Limited provides precision measurement systems and solutions that are applicable in semiconductor laboratories and factories.
summary: Quatek International Limited is a leading agent for Electronic Precision Measurement Systems, serving various industries including semiconductor, nanotechnology, and high-tech materials. They offer a range of services including instrument installation, product training, and R&D support, aimed at enhancing customer competitiveness in the semiconductor market.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Quatek has branch offices in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Kaohsiung to provide services in Taiwan.
regional_presence.China: The company has established offices in major cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing, Xiamen, Xi'an, Chengdu, and Wuhu to enhance customer service in China.
